notes.title: Minor fix
notes.content: Another minor bug fix... nothing to worry about: neither Yanko-chan not the computer club were involved...

notes.title: Ending songs fixed
notes.content: There were some problems with the subtitles for the Kurumi ending song. Also, the ending song of Yanko sometimes did not play. Both is fixed now. We apologize for the problem.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.content: Yanko-chan's music went missing at one point in the game. We've found it again, and now it'll play for sure. Enjoy!

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content: We were not able to make the game [i]even[/i] cuter, but at least we solved some small problems. :)
